summary: Finished item 'session' after the review. Both must-fix findings are fixed and tested. (1) A damaged session row whose Library kind is a list or an object no longer stops the start: destination() looks the kind up only when it is text, and the Library opens on 'all'. The reviewer's probe, part B, now starts for library-list and library-dict in both looks. (2) A saved row with no title, which is every row 0.8.3 wrote, is now named by what the screen calls its kind. A new map, SHOWN_AS, holds each kind's tab title. I measured those titles in a real window for 102 openers, and they are the same in both looks. StacyFoundationTab now reads 'Graphite · knowledge' in the Activity line and in Arrange → Reopen deferred tabs. A kind this Graphite no longer opens still reads as words made from its class name, passed through assistant_identity.named, so the internal name never shows. I also did five of the should-fix items: the told filter has a test, the Activity line opens Reopen deferred tabs instead of Commands, the silent except now prints its trace, the dead FilesStart branch is removed, and the report count is corrected. test_session_start ran 28 tests, OK in both looks. Its importers are OK in both looks: test_delete_words 6, test_one_name 19, test_graphite 29, test_release_check 23. Each of the five fixed pieces, reverted on its own, turns its tests red. The patch is rewritten and applies to a clean HEAD tree.

decisions: Must-fix 1 is fixed in destination() only. The Session cleaner (workbench/session.py) is not changed. The review allowed either ('and/or'). session.py is imported by about 30 test modules, and each would need a run in both looks. 'folder' and 'title' were already safe at every place they are read. The probe confirms all three keys, damaged, now start.

SHOWN_AS is a fixed map, not a live lookup. Most of these titles come from each tab's own title() method, which needs a built tab. The SecondStart test compares the map with the real window's titles for the rooms it opens, so a renamed title is caught there.

A kind not in the map (retired kinds, project-only tabs I could not open without a project, ConcernDossier, whose title is the concern's name) is still named by its class words, now passed through assistant_identity.named. Before this fix it was also class words, but without named(). None of the current ones holds the internal name. I did not invent a name for ConcernDossier.
The SHOWN_AS entry 'PdfDocumentTab': 'A PDF' is not a title from the screen. On screen a PDF tab shows its file name, but a saved PDF row has no path, only store ids.
The CODE_KEPT reason for 'StacyFoundationTab' in tools/name_sweep.py now says the kind is shown as its title (SHOWN_AS). The literal is a dictionary key and is never shown.
When the Activity line is opened, it calls the strip's reopen_deferred. If the list is already empty, nothing opens, as before for an empty list.
not_done: No test measures start time. With 16 rooms open a start takes about 2 s longer, the same cost as opening those rooms by hand. I did not trace which room starts the 4 short subprocesses.
The Session cleaner does not check 'library', 'folder' or 'title' (see decisions).

I did not open the project-only tabs (Orange Book, NOR, Hardware review and others) with a project attached, so they are not in SHOWN_AS. Without a title they still read as their class words, which hold no internal name.
I did not rerun the full 102-opener sweep. The restore paths it covered are unchanged, apart from the dead FilesStart branch, which no row could reach.
Nothing was run on the owner's ThinkPad. Nothing was committed, and wip/, the version, MANIFEST.json and the seed are untouched.
release_note: Graphite now reopens every tab you left open at your last session: Documents, Files in the folder you were in, the Library, the Agenda, DELETE, Changes, Night Shift, Investigations, the app rooms and the tool tabs, each in its place. Arrange → Reopen deferred tabs no longer grows at every start. It holds each tab once, and never more than twenty. When a start cannot reopen a tab, it says so once in the Activity, in plain words and by the tab's name as you see it on screen. Opening that line takes you to the list. A damaged session file, and leaving with Night Shift open, no longer stop Graphite or lose your session.
